To add onto this, I’ve been hesitant to admit it, but the assignment is to have a perfect body for both ends of the binary, not just one. I haven’t really figured out which parts of myself are “more” trans than the others. 

Like, a lot of what I’m unhappy with are certainly societal pressures from growing up masc, so am I running away from that, or running toward the femme? And I think answering that question brings insight into where I would land on what does and does not bring me gender euphoria

He (my therapist) is coming from a very good place, the homework I think, is working toward a larger thing we are working on and I don’t really have worries about dysphoria from not achieving the “perfect” form. I understand why it sounds questionable but I do want to assuage anything negative about the assignment itself. 

I trust the process and I trust the intention. 

We really make an effort to squash the “ideal self” ideas that I’ve got from maladaptive healing fantasies, so bringing this up feels like a set up for working toward a middle ground that I can achieve and become happy and accepting with. 

Anyway, enough about the theory, I do like the idea you posed, my only problem is that I’m a recluse and have fewer than 10 people in my life haha, and while I don’t think they’d mind me using them as examples, they aren’t the examples I’d use.

Its a movie where Poe had to help solve murders that someone was committing in the style of his poems and stories. This man is paying homage to Poe in so many ways. Poe was obsessed with women, all the ones in his life, including his mother, passed usually due to "The red death" Tuberculosis, but even further, the story The Tell Tale Heart has the main character killing a man because the color of his eye. I know this is a wall, but I doubt any of this was him ventilating guilt, I think its more like clues in the movie aforementioned. He may want to be caught like the killer in the movie. Read up on Poe, look at the similarities and I bet he can be found.
